How to use

Privacy and research data

The app saves drafts in this browser’s local storage. There is no account, answer-submission endpoint, advertising, analytics script or embedded X widget. Switching languages on the same site retains answers. Another browser, device or domain has separate storage. The hosting provider may process normal connection and security logs; this is distinct from questionnaire answers.

Exported files may contain personal information. You choose whether and where to share them; the receiving service’s own terms apply. Reset removes this browser’s questionnaire draft but cannot delete files you downloaded or records already shared with another AI.

Feedback on X is optional and public. Do not post your relationship sheet or private conversations there. Report the question ID, language, version and a non-sensitive description. Social-media reactions and usability feedback concern the experiment; they are not automatically inserted into anyone’s relationship record.
